always.description: Settings for forwarding all incoming calls to the destination you choose.

selective.description: Selectively forward calls to a designated number, depending on criteria rules. You'll need to have at least one rule for forwarding applied for call forwarding to be active.

rules.description: Rules for selectively forwarding calls. (Rules which are omitted in the list will not be deleted.)

operatingModes.description: Configuration for forwarding via Operating modes (Schedule Based Routing).

enabled.description: Indicates whether operating modes forwarding is enabled.
